platforms.name: Viki · free episodes
platforms.accessTier: Free listing; sign-in and ads may apply
platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode API https://api.viki.io/v4/series/41705c/episodes.json?app=100000a&per_page=50 returned HTTP 200, x-geoip-country-code=us and 48 records, including a separate Special Episode numbered 48. Episodes 1–6 have blocked=false, blocking.geo=false, blocking.paywall=false, blocking.upcoming=false, flags.has_stream=true and subtitle_completions.en=100. This is a US-scoped metadata check; actual player playback was not tested and future access is not guaranteed.

platforms.name: Viki · Viki Pass episodes
platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode API returned x-geoip-country-code=us. Episodes 7–47 have blocked=true because blocking.paywall=true, with blocking.geo=false, blocking.upcoming=false, paywallable.svod=true, flags.has_stream=true and subtitle_completions.en=100. Entry 48 is titled Special Episode and is listed separately, not treated as another regular story episode. Actual subscribed player playback was not tested; no finale date or worldwide access claim is inferred.

platforms.name: Viki · Special Episode (listed as 48)
platforms.accessTier: Viki Pass subscription; special, not a regular story episode
platforms.evidence: The US-scoped official Viki episode API titles entry 48 Special Episode. It has blocking.paywall=true, blocking.geo=false, blocking.upcoming=false, paywallable.svod=true, flags.has_stream=true and subtitle_completions.en=100. This distinguishes Viki's 48-entry catalog from WeTV's All 47 EPs label without asserting cross-platform cut equivalence. Actual playback and the special's story coverage were not checked.

platforms.name: WeTV · English-language listing
platforms.conflict: WeTV's 'All 47 EPs' label is catalog length, not proof that 47 subtitled episodes can be played in the US or another country. Player/region access and English subtitles were not established.
platforms.evidence: Rechecked the official WeTV English-language series listing, which still displays 'All 47 EPs'. No episode-player test was performed. Territory, access tier, playable episode range and English subtitle availability remain unknown.

history.note: New official-source review to resolve the closing-readings release blocker. Viki's title page, WeTV's English title page and Tencent's title URL returned HTTP 200. Viki's episode API returned HTTP 200 and x-geoip-country-code=us with 48 entries: Episodes 1–6 free, Episodes 7–47 subscription, and a separate Special Episode numbered 48. Every entry reports English subtitles at 100%, an available stream, no geo block and no upcoming block. WeTV still displays All 47 EPs. No player playback, non-US territorial rights, mainland episode range, cross-platform cut equivalence or finale timing was established. Historical review dates below are unchanged.

Rechecked official Viki, WeTV and Tencent title links and the Viki episode API. US-scoped API metadata supports free Episodes 1–6 and subscription Episodes 7–42 with English subtitles at 100%; actual player playback was not tested. Viki's 43-tile section is not an additional verified episode. WeTV still labels its catalog All 47 EPs; territorial playback and finale timing remain unverified. Historical evidence dates are preserved below.
